title: Buying a New Phone
description: Four short recordings about phones: in a shop, a call to customer service, two friends talking and a shop announcement.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · In the shop
parts.intro: You will hear Mai talking to a shop assistant, Jack, about a new phone.

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: Good afternoon. Can I help you?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Yes, please. I need a new phone. My old one is three years old and the battery only lasts half a day.

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: I see. What do you use your phone for?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Mostly photos and music. I don't play many games.

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: Then this one is good. It has a very good camera and it's light. It's two hundred and fifty pounds.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Hmm, that's a bit expensive. I have about two hundred pounds. Do you have anything cheaper?

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: This blue one is one hundred and ninety-nine pounds. The camera is not as good, but the battery lasts two days.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Two days is great! Can I see it in black, though? I don't really like blue.

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: Sorry, we only have blue and white in the shop. We can order black, but it takes a week.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Oh, then I'll take the white one. Do I get a case?

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: Yes, a free case comes with it. And you can pay today and take it home right now.

parts.title: Part 2 · A phone call
parts.intro: You will hear Linh calling customer service about her new phone.

script.speaker: Paul
script.text: Hello, Techworld customer service, Paul speaking.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Hi, Paul. I bought a phone from your shop last Saturday, and there's a problem with it.

script.speaker: Paul
script.text: I'm sorry to hear that. What's wrong?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: The screen goes black when I make a call. I can't hear the other person.

script.speaker: Paul
script.text: Hmm. Have you tried turning it off and on again?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Yes, twice. And I updated it too, but nothing changed.

script.speaker: Paul
script.text: OK. Then you should bring it back to the shop. We can look at it, and you can have a new one if we can't fix it.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Can I come tomorrow? I work until five o'clock.

script.speaker: Paul
script.text: The shop closes at six, so that's fine. Please bring your receipt and the box.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: I don't have the box. I threw it away. Is that a problem?

script.speaker: Paul
script.text: No, no, the receipt is the important thing. Ask for Mr Brown at the desk.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Great. Thank you very much for your help.

parts.title: Part 3 · Two friends
parts.intro: You will hear Nam asking his friend Emma for advice about buying a phone.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Emma, can I ask your opinion? I want to buy a new phone, but I can't decide.

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: Sure. What are you thinking about?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Well, my cousin has a big phone with a huge screen. It's great for films, but it doesn't fit in my pocket.

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: Yes, mine is quite big too. I sometimes drop it. I prefer a smaller one now.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: That's true. Also, I read that a cheaper model is nearly the same as the expensive one.

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: Really? Which one?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: The green one at the shop near the station. It costs half the price of the famous one.

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: Well, I'd check the reviews first. And ask about the guarantee. Mine has a two-year guarantee, and that's useful.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Good idea. Honestly, I don't care about colour. I only want a phone that doesn't break.

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: Then maybe buy a strong case too. I always do.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: OK. I'll go on Saturday. Do you want to come with me?

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: I'd love to, but I'm visiting my grandma. Why don't you send me photos?

parts.title: Part 4 · A shop announcement
parts.intro: You will hear an announcement in a phone shop.

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Welcome to Techworld. Here is an important announcement for all our customers.

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: This weekend, we have a special sale on phones, headphones and speakers. All phones will be twenty per cent cheaper, and headphones are only ten pounds.

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: The sale starts on Friday at nine o'clock and finishes on Sunday evening. On Sunday, the shop will close early, at five o'clock, not at eight.

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: If you buy a phone this weekend, you can get a free screen protector. Please ask at the front desk.

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Our repair centre has moved to the second floor, next to the café. It is now open every day, even on Sundays.

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Finally, a small boy is waiting at the information desk. He is about six years old, and he is wearing a red jumper. His name is Tim. Please come and find him, mum or dad.
